site: Workday (Marathon Petroleum posting; any posting whose Apply is a link)
class: The way a step was entered depended on the plan's own label for it, so a mislabelled plan sent a harmless link through the click path that must refuse it
symptom: On Marathon's posting the agent stopped at the first page with 'final submission is only available through the verified gateway or human handoff', every attempt.
root_cause: Workday's Apply is an <a role=button href='.../apply'>. press_next followed such a link by GET only when the plan's next_kind was open_application; when the plan called it a next or final step it was clicked, and the submission guard correctly refused a click on a control labelled Apply.
why_tests_missed: The one entry test always built its plan with next_kind=open_application, the label the code expected.
fix: press_next follows an Apply-labelled link with a GET on a posting page whatever the plan's next_kind, before any gate or click. follow_application_entry still refuses non-posting pages, form links, fragments and job boards.
prevention: Decide how to enter a step from what the control is (a link with an address), not from what the planner called it.
